info.title: Lightning node-manager API
info.description: Contract-freeze candidate under approved-scope.md. One operator, native passkeys, same public HTTPS origin, server-configured nodes, LND gRPC/LND REST/CLNRest. All JSON bodies use application/json. Session/preauthentication cookies are HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict, Path=/, without Domain; challenges and sessions are server-side. All responses use Cache-Control: no-store. Non-GET requests require exact configured Origin and X-CSRF-Token from the corresponding session. GET auth/bootstrap creates anonymous preauthentication state without requiring an authenticated CSRF token; see contract-notes.md. No node credentials or secret preimages are public. Decimal amounts are strings, never JSON numbers. No mutation retries or offline queues. Only nodes/{node_id} selects a node.

servers.description: Same HTTPS origin; never a node endpoint

200.description: Authenticated session, linked identity, or removal
Operation-bound Nostr challenge or recent-auth grant

get.summary: Create or refresh anonymous preauthentication context
get.description: Allowed without login or CSRF. Validate Host against configured public origin; reject cross-site Fetch Metadata and mismatched Origin when supplied. No CORS. Sets opaque preauth cookie and returns its CSRF token. Bounded lifetime/rate. Never grants enrollment by itself.

200.description: Anonymous context; Set-Cookie contains no browser-readable session state

post.description: Consumes the server-held challenge once. Verifies library authentication result with user verification. Rotates into a new authenticated session, invalidates preauth state and returns a new CSRF token. No password fallback.

Requires a short-lived single-use host-issued enrollment token bound to the fixed operator and RP/origin. Token is atomically claimed at start, never in a URL/log. No public initial-user registration or reset. Backup authenticator enrollment uses another host-issued token.
Consumes registration state once, validates via webauthn-rs, persists operator credential before granting a new session. Enrollment completion does not authorize a strict-mode sensitive operation.

delete.description: Revoke server session, ceremonies and operation grants; expire cookie. Does not cancel dispatched node actions.

get.description: Authenticated safe application policy only. No config CRUD, paths, URLs of nodes, certificates, secrets or credential material.
Registry remains available with partial/offline fleet. Each node has independent network/read-only/health/freshness. Sorted by configured id ascending. No fleet money totals.

200.description: Registry node, current capabilities and last observed status
Observed identity/info; cached data marked stale
Local connection status, never an implicit health probe with writes

get.description: Configured limits in explicit units, not evidence of available funds or upstream authorization. All configured amount and fee limits are server authoritative; no browser override above bounds.
Observational estimates only. Missing/unavailable estimates are null, not hard-coded prices. Application never submits a mutation to estimate fees.

200.description: Observed money, no fabricated zero fallback
Created_at descending, hash ascending tie-break; aggregate all parts of each payment
All local open/pending/closed channels, id ascending
Occurred_at descending, null dates last, txid ascending tie-break

post.description: Local maintained BOLT11 parser; works for read-only/offline configured node. Returns parsed network/match/expiry, does not pay or reserve anything. Malformed/unsupported BOLT11 => 422. Unknown node network yields network_matches_node=null and still blocks payment creation.

get.description: Journal available even when node offline/read-only. nonterminal includes awaiting_confirmation/dispatching/pending/unknown. Created_at descending, id ascending tie-break. Status reads reconcile only; never dispatch.

post.description: Creates immutable reviewed operation only, NEVER calls a node mutation. Reject read-only/offline/unverified/syncing/policy-invalid nodes. Same key+canonical input replays existing operation (200); changed input =>409. Semantic locks also prevent different-key duplicate/conflicting unresolved intents. All eight mutation kinds use this pipeline.

Sensitive operations only. every_operation ALWAYS starts a fresh UV-required passkey ceremony bound server-side to session+operation+node identity+review digest. recent mode may issue one-use operation grant only within configured recent-auth window; otherwise requires ceremony. No UI-supplied duration or mode. Never dispatches. Expired/changed-policy/identity/read-only review fails closed.

Consume ceremony once and verify fresh passkey user verification. Grants exact reviewed operation only. Does not dispatch. Revoked sessions, expired review/challenge or changed node binding fail closed.

Recheck session, identity, network, policy revision, read-only, sync/capabilities, limits and review expiry; atomically consume grant and claim dispatch ONCE. Low-risk operations require authorization_id=null; sensitive ones require an unexpired grant for THIS operation. Repeated confirms of an already-claimed operation return its state without another RPC/grant consumption, even after grant expiry; an authenticated GET is preferred. No queue, replay or automatic money retry. After possible dispatch, missing response is pending/unknown, never a retryable false failure.

SessionCookie.name: __Host-ld_session
SessionCookie.description: Opaque server-side revocable session; never store in JS. SameSite Strict/Secure/HttpOnly.

PreauthCookie.name: __Host-ld_preauth
PreauthCookie.description: Anonymous server-side ceremony context issued by GET auth/bootstrap; not an authenticated application session.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Browser-supplied exact public HTTPS origin; reject missing/null/mismatch on non-GET. Do not set manually in browser fetch.

Csrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
Csrf.description: Token from preauth bootstrap for anonymous ceremonies, authenticated session for all other non-GET. Rotate on login; constant-time library comparison.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Persist one key for the explicit intent, not per fetch attempt. Scoped to node; same key survives logout/restart in SQLite. Semantic locks additionally constrain different keys.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Omit for configured default (initial default 50); reject above configured maximum (hard protocol ceiling 200). Central pagination policy returned by /config.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque snapshot cursor bound to session, node identity, resource, filters and page limit. Not an upstream token. Expired=>410 cursor_expired; mismatched=>400 invalid_cursor.

SafeError.description: Safe JSON error. 400 malformed/cursor; 401 session; 403 csrf/origin/read_only; 404 resource; 409 idempotency/resource/auth/review conflict; 410 cursor expired; 415 content type; 422 invalid amount/invoice/address/policy; 429 throttled; 502 upstream schema; 503 offline/config/storage. A known potentially dispatched action is returned as Operation, not advertised retryable.

Retry-After.description: Seconds, required on 429; only observational/login retry guidance, never permission to retry a mutation

Session.description: Current authenticated session and its CSRF token; completion routes rotate to a new opaque cookie/token. GET does not rotate CSRF on every read.

AuthenticationChallenge.description: Protocol JSON options from webauthn-rs, server-bound one-time challenge

Operation.description: Current operation; read does not submit or retry node mutation

OperationAccepted.description: Durably claimed; not necessarily completed or broadcast. Location identifies status read.

Pubkey.description: Compressed secp256k1 public node identity. Backend additionally validates point encoding. Examples are fabricated, not live node identities.

Decimal.description: Canonical integer 0..9223372036854775807, range regex generated from i64::MAX with absolute-end assertion (including no trailing newline). Backend additionally performs checked parsing and resource-specific configured bounds. No signs, leading zeros, fractions or exponent.

PositiveDecimal.description: Canonical integer 1..9223372036854775807, range regex generated from i64::MAX with absolute-end assertion. Backend still performs checked parsing and configured bounds.

ReauthPolicy.description: Positive configured duration only in recent mode; null in every_operation. Only pay/send/open/close are sensitive; no browser override.

enrollment_available.description: Host bootstrap currently armed; not an enrollment authorization

Base64Url.description: Unpadded base64url bytes, never hex or raw ArrayBuffer. Cryptographic validity checked only by WebAuthn library.

AuthenticationOptions.description: webauthn-rs RequestChallengeResponse JSON wrapper. Pass options.publicKey as optionsJSON to @simplewebauthn/browser startAuthentication, or platform parseRequestOptionsFromJSON then navigator.credentials.get. Normative WebAuthn JSON, not invented Rust bytes. Extra library extensions validated by library.

RegistrationOptions.description: webauthn-rs CreationChallengeResponse JSON. Feed options.publicKey to startRegistration({optionsJSON}), or platform parseCreationOptionsFromJSON then navigator.credentials.create. User verification required by server passkey flow. Library owns cryptographic/extension validation.

AuthenticationCredential.description: AuthenticationResponseJSON from browser helper or PublicKeyCredential.toJSON(); server deserializes webauthn-rs PublicKeyCredential and validates cryptographically. Examples are protocol-shaped dummy bytes, not valid assertions.

RegistrationCredential.description: RegistrationResponseJSON from browser helper or platform toJSON(); server validates via webauthn-rs RegisterPublicKeyCredential, never hand-rolled FIDO verification.

OperationAuthorization.description: Opaque identifier is not bearer authority: valid only in issuing live session for this node/operation/digest/policy. One-use, expires no later than review and relevant auth window. Not restored after restart.

Capability.description: enabled=true iff reason=null. On read-only nodes every mutation reason is read_only regardless of availability. No write probes to discover permission.

synced_to_graph.description: CLN/no equivalent =>null, not true by assumption

identity_revision.description: Opaque verified binding revision; includes expected/observed identity/network and connection configuration. Never contains endpoint or credential.

NodeBinding.description: Immutable verified binding; review never uses unknown network. Public identity only, no connection secrets.

NodePolicy.description: Money limits must be explicitly configured centrally for writable nodes; example values are not product defaults. max routing fee is a hard pay limit; fee-rate bounds constrain requested on-chain rates, not a fabricated total fee quote. Return 503 not_configured rather than inventing missing policy.

Balances.description: Confirmed/unconfirmed wallet amounts and channel ownership are not spendability. Unsupported/unavailable measurements are null. If no usable observation exists, return503 instead of plausible zeros.

Bolt11.description: BOLT11 string validated by maintained library; schema intentionally does not claim checksum/semantic validation. Dummy fixture strings are not payable.

address.description: Peer P2P address, never application-to-node RPC endpoint

amount_sat.description: Absolute wallet net change, not sum of recipient outputs; null if adapter cannot derive reliably. direction carries sign.

amount_msat.description: Required positive amount only for amountless invoice; null for fixed invoice. No overriding fixed amounts.

description.description: Required preimage text for description-hash invoices where backend requires it; hash must match locally; otherwise null.

host.description: Validated P2P DNS/IP/onion host only, no scheme/path/userinfo. Backend P2P network/egress allowlist enforced; not RPC address selection.

address_type.description: MVP common native SegWit receive address; no taproot parity claim

FeeReview.description: Only max_fee_msat is a hard total routing fee cap. On-chain estimate is not a quote. Cooperative close negotiates with peer and cannot promise a fixed total fee; backend discloses this control instead of fabricating parity.

OperationReview.description: Render immutable server review, not client form. Effective pay amount is here even when input amount_msat=null. digest covers request, identity/network, effective values, fee policy, expiry and policy revision. No preimage or node connection data.

AuthorizationStatus.description: Projection for requesting session; not a durable transferable grant. Obtain authorization_id through authorize endpoints; never persist it in browser storage.

authorization_id.description: Null for low-risk mutation; exact session-bound grant required for sensitive operation in either reauth mode

OperationResult.description: References may be available before final success, so result can be non-null in pending/unknown. Const/enum kind fields form a disjoint JSON Schema union without implicit discriminator mappings for inline branches. Never contains payment preimage, PSBT or raw transaction.

Operation.description: Kind lives at request.kind (no second divergent kind field). Immutable request/review; state/result/error are authoritative projections. succeeded+broadcast send is node-reported publication, not chain confirmation. pay succeeds only settled; open only active; close only observed closed. failed requires definite failure evidence; unknown may resolve later without another spending RPC.

truncated.description: True if bounded snapshot omitted older/additional upstream records. null next_cursor never means complete upstream history when truncated=true. Narrow filters or adjust configured snapshot bound, not pretend parity.

PageMeta.description: Fleet node_id/network=null; node pages carry their explicit binding. Snapshot observation time, not HTTP response time. Cursor paging can return stale cached records. No initial node observation =>503, not an empty healthy list.
